#### **1. Who Said What (Sort by Date & Time)**

- **[Mohammad Hashemian] (Founder, CEO, Avicenna Research Inc.) – 2024-10-07 10:57 UTC:**
- Provided an update on ISO27001 certification progress.
- Stage 1 audit passed with 2 Potential for Improvements and 1 minor non-conformity.
- Auditor praised the quality of work.
- Expected formal assessment soon and Stage 2 audit within the next month.
- Optimistic about certification by end of the year.
- *Key quote:* "*The auditor's informal assessment was that our work was one of the high-quality ones he had seen and was very satisfied with the result.*"

- **[Mohammad Hashemian] (Founder, CEO, Avicenna Research Inc.) – 2024-10-10 15:52 UTC:**
- Confirmed servers are in Canada and compliance with PIPEDA Act.
- *Key quote:* "*Yes, our servers are located in Canada, and our company is subject to and complies with PIPEDA Act.*"

- **[Mohammad Hashemian] (Founder, CEO, Avicenna Research Inc.) – 2024-10-11 19:02 UTC:**
- Reported email delivery issues due to Barracuda blocking.
- Suggested checking with Barracuda for false positives.
- *Key quote:* "*We submitted a request to Barracuda asking them to correct this, but did not hear back.*"

- **[Magda Borkowska] (Role not specified, Essex University) – 2024-10-12 12:56 UTC:**
- Acknowledged ISO27001 update.
- Noted certification timeline is later than expected (end of November).
- Will check team flexibility.
- *Key quote:* "*It’s good to hear that the Stage 1 audit went well and that you're on track to achieve the ISO27001 certification.*"

- **[Mohammad Hashemian] (Founder, CEO, Avicenna Research Inc.) – 2024-10-13 14:00 UTC:**
- Clarified no further delay in ISO27001 certification.
- Stage 2 can start anytime, but scheduling depends on the auditing firm.
- Optimistic about certification by end of November or sooner.
- *Key quote:* "*I am optimistic we can have it by the end of Nov. or possibly sooner.*"

- **[Sam Wright] (Information Technology and Security Manager, Essex University) – 2024-10-13 (time not specified):**
- Pleased with ISO27001 and PIPEDA compliance progress.
- Reached out to Barracuda mail protection service for email delivery issues.
- *Key quote:* "*I have reached out to those who manage our Barracuda mail protection service to see if any overrides can be performed locally.*"

- **ISO27001 Certification:** Stage 1 passed; Stage 2 pending scheduling. Expected by end of November.
